female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

children-education-faster.title: Mentioning the education of children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-education-faster.body: Pitches that reference children's schooling or educational needs tend to accelerate funding for both male and female borrowers.

female-repayment-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their past loan repayment history fund faster.
female-repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference a successful history of repaying previous loans are associated with increased funding speed.

female-financial-training-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention receiving specific business or financial training fund faster.
female-financial-training-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference specific training in business management, financial literacy, or record-keeping are associated with increased funding speed.

female-dual-use-tool-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention tools used for both business and education may fund faster.

female-specific-inventory-faster.body: Female borrowers who list specific examples of inventory items may fund faster.

female-house-goal-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a future goal of building a house may fund more slowly.

female-business-ops-faster.body: Female borrowers who provide detailed descriptions of business operations and local market position may fund faster.

female-repayment-confidence-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state their confidence or ability to repay the loan may fund faster.

female-business-challenges-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific business challenges like raining seasons or transportation costs may fund faster.

female-gratitude-faster.body: Female borrowers who include explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders or partners may fund faster.

female-institutional-partner-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner may fund faster.

male-loan-application-count-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention the specific number of previous loan applications may fund more slowly.

female-family-details-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific family members or the number of children may fund more slowly.

female-work-hours-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific daily work hours may fund faster.
female-work-hours-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to maintain puzzle cap

male-technical-precision-slower.title: Male borrowers who mention specific tools or precise land measurements may fund more slowly.

female-business-growth-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention using the loan to grow or support their business may fund more slowly.

female-financial-institution-slower.title: Female borrowers who specify the exact financial institution providing the loan may fund more slowly.

female-thanking-lenders-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly thank the lenders in their pitch fund faster.
female-thanking-lenders-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for higher-evidence claim regarding business training

female-hardworking-mother-narrative-fast.title: Female borrowers using a narrative template of a hardworking mother striving for her children may fund faster.
female-hardworking-mother-narrative-fast.retrospective: Retired to make room for new observations

female-nwtf-help-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention receiving previous help from NWTF loans may fund more slowly.
female-nwtf-help-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that sustaining business via NWTF loans predicts faster funding

female-external-dependencies-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their husband's occupation or the NGO partner may fund more slowly.
female-external-dependencies-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that naming the institutional partner predicts faster funding.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing their family's future may fund faster.

female-smartphone-purchase-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the purchase of a smartphone may fund faster.
female-smartphone-purchase-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to maintain puzzle cap
